subject.title: fix(codex): project absolute thread tokenUsage into attemptUsage

question: Should this implementation be closed in favor of waiting for a producer-owned current-window value, or should maintainers sponsor another narrowly defined source for trustworthy Codex context usage?
rationale: The present mapping is contradicted by the upstream protocol semantics and the existing regression invariant, while choosing another source requires ownership of the session-accounting contract rather than a mechanical patch revision.

options.title: Reject cumulative mapping
options.body: Close or replace this approach and retain unknown context state until Codex exposes a trustworthy current-window snapshot.

options.title: Sponsor another source
options.body: Keep the underlying issue open and define an explicit, tested producer-owned field or runtime seam that OpenClaw may safely persist as fresh context usage.

options.title: Accept approximation
options.body: Intentionally treat cumulative thread usage as current context despite the known inflation and session-state compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Reject cumulative mapping
recommendation.body: Close or replace this approach and retain unknown context state until Codex exposes a trustworthy current-window snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the existing invariant and issued the direct protocol-contract decision on this PR.
